fullDescription: A futuristic and premium edtech-focused style guide featuring glassmorphism, vibrant accents, and high-performance layout patterns. Defined by the pairing of 'Clash Display' and 'Satoshi' typography, the aesthetic uses a clean white mesh background accented by soft radial gradients in blue (#3b82f6) and lavender (#a78bfa). Key features include interactive glass cards with 32px corner radii, floating UI badges, and a custom spotlight cursor interaction. It is highly suitable for modern SaaS dashboards, fintech landing pages, and educational platforms seeking a professional yet cutting-edge 'Dribbble-quality' feel.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, high-contrast design system utilizing white space, glassmorphic containers, and vibrant color-coded service grids to create a premium educational or professional services interface.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a 'Mesh Background' aesthetic: white base with radial gradients of #3b82f6 and #a78bfa at 5-10% opacity. Typography: Headings in 'Clash Display' (bold, tracking-tight), body in 'Satoshi' (medium, 1.1 leading). Colors: Primary Blue (#3b82f6), Lavender (#a78bfa), Slate Text (#0f172a). UI elements: Cards must have 2rem (32px) rounded corners, background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and a 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) border. Buttons: Pill-shaped, bg-slate-900 or primary-blue, with a hover scale of 1.05 and shadow-glow effect of 0 0 25px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4). Animations: 6s vertical floating loops for badges; spotlight effect using a radial gradient (600px circle) following the cursor.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navbar
Sticky header with glassmorphism (60% white, 12px blur). Height 20 units (80px). Left: Logo with a 40x40px gradient icon (#3b82f6 to #a78bfa) and 12px rounded corners. Center: Horizontal links with 2px bottom-border hover transitions. Right: Login text link and a primary pill-shaped 'CTA' button.

### Hero Section
Top padding: 160px. Center-aligned text. Headline: 'Clash Display' at 72px with a specific gradient span (#3b82f6 to #a78bfa). Subtext: 20px slate-600. CTA: Dual buttons (Primary Glow and Secondary Play-icon). Surround with 2 absolute-positioned floating glass badges containing progress icons and dynamic stats. Bottom: A row of 4 horizontal glass badges with icons and labels.

### Service Grid
Responsive grid (Desktop: 3-col, Tablet: 2-col, Mobile: 1-col). Gap: 2rem. Each card: Glass container, 32px rounded corners. Header: 64x64px color-coded icon container with 16px radius (e.g., bg-blue-100/text-blue-600). Hover effect: -8px Y-translation, subtle gradient background reveal (5% opacity), and 'Learn More' arrow icon slide animation.

### High-Contrast Value Section
Full-width section with bg-slate-900. Text: White and light-blue (#60a5fa). Layout: 2-column. Left: Bold 60px headline and icon-based feature list (2x2 grid). Right: A decorative 3D floating card with a gradient background (#3b82f6 to #a78bfa), displaying a large metric (e.g., '4.2Cr+') and celebration icon.

### Footer
5-column layout. Column 1: Logo and social icons in circular bg-slate-50 containers. Columns 2-4: Thematic link categories with font-bold headers. Column 5: Legal links. Bottom bar: Border-top with 14px slate-400 text and heart icon.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Glass Card — High-gloss card with inner shadow and hover state.
Base: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), backdrop-filter blur(12px), border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), border-radius 32px. Hover: translate-y(-8px), box-shadow 0 20px 40px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1), background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05), rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.05)).

### Glow CTA Button — A pill-shaped button that radiates light on hover.
Shape: Pill (full rounded). Background: #3b82f6 (Primary) or #0f172a (Action). Transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Hover: scale 1.05, shadow 0 0 25px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4). Internal: Includes an icon that translates +4px on the X-axis during hover.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the 32px corner radius for all cards to keep the 'modern' feel. DO NOT use sharp corners or heavy black borders; use rgba white borders for glass effects. MUST implement the 'spotlight' cursor effect to provide depth to the white background. Animation timing should be strictly 500ms for card transitions and 6s for floating elements to ensure a premium, non-jittery experience.

style.description: The style is built on a foundation of 'Clash Display' for impactful headings and 'Satoshi' for readable body text. It utilizes a core palette of Electric Blue (#3b82f6) and Lavender (#c4b5fd) set against a mesh-gradient white background. Visual interest is maintained through glassmorphic cards (60% opacity white, 12px blur), pill-shaped buttons with 25px glow shadows, and smooth 500ms transitions. Micro-interactions include a floating animation for key badges and a cursor-tracking spotlight effect.
